title: Mario Mushano no Chou Shougi Juku: Mario Mushano's Hyper Shogi School
native_title: マリオ武者野の超将棋塾
overview:
A shogi-improvement program fully supervised by 6-dan Katsumi Mushano, known as "Mario Mushano" sensei from NHK's "Shogi Lessons" - while reinforcing your weak points,

[Skill Building] Your shogi will get stronger!
Over 200 "next move" problems are provided. In addition to conventional formats such as "opening," "middle game," and "endgame," it includes problem formats that train a more practical sense, such as "reading" and "overall board view," which were well received on NHK's Shogi Lessons. You can naturally strengthen areas that were hard to train until now. The problems were created by 6-dan Mushano. Their quality is completely different from the problems you find around.

[Skill Analysis] A chart diagnosis of your shogi!
Your current strength is analyzed from many angles, making your weaknesses and strengths easy to see and clear.

[Rank Certification] Obtain an official certificate on the recommendation of 6-dan Katsumi Mushano!
6-dan Katsumi Mushano certifies your playing strength. The certification result and the certificate application documents are sent back to you. If you apply and pay the set fee, you can obtain an official "1-dan" or "2-dan" certificate on the recommendation of 6-dan Katsumi Mushano.

[Supported by a Pro!]
Detailed questions about the software or shogi are fully supported on the BBS network "Koma-oto."

NHK「将棋講座」でお馴染みの「マリオ武者野」先生こと武者野勝巳六段完全監修による将棋上達ソフト弱点を補強しながら

【実力養成】あなたの将棋は強くなる！
200題を越える「次の一手」を用意。「序盤」「中盤」「終盤」などの従来の形式に加え、NHK将棋講座で評判になった「読み」「大局観」など、より実戦に即した感覚を鍛える問題形式も取り入れました。今まで鍛えにくかった分野を自然に強化することができます。問題は武者野六段作成です。巷の問題とは質が全然違います。

【実力分析判断】あなたの将棋をチャート診断！
現在のあなたの実力を多角的に分析、短所と長所を判りやすく明確にします。

【段位認定】武者野勝巳六段の推薦により、正式免状が取れる！
武者野勝巳六段が棋力を認定。その認定結果と免状申請書類を返送します。所定の費用で申請すれば、武者野勝巳六段の推薦により「初段」「二段」の正式免状が取得できます。

【プロ棋士がサポート！】
ソフトや将棋に関する詳しい質問などは、BBSネット「駒音」でフルサポートします。
